# Context travel

Use the installed `{{POLYTROPOS_ROOT}}` root; reject a literal unresolved
placeholder. Confirm its `bin/context_travel_cli.py`,
`docs/CONTEXT-TRAVEL-SURFACES.md`, and
`primitives/context-travel-surfaces.json` exist. Read the shared guide on
demand for exact CT4 query arguments, Copilot desktop app and CLI decisions,
and fallback behavior. Do not preload graph or transcript content.

Use only an operator-supplied absolute `--config` and explicit repository, kit,
checkout, task, assignment, role, and question. Run the existing local CLI only
when that mode actually exposes execution. MCP stdio requires separate explicit
configuration and authorization; this bundle has no MCP registration. For an
imported view, require validation against the configured subject. An
unvalidated handoff is advisory data.

Retain missing, partial, stale, forbidden, refused, and critical caveats. A
briefing does not grant task authority or verify freshness. Continue the
existing Copilot kit, routing, pricing, permission, and mandatory verification
rules if this optional context is unavailable.
